title: Nuit Interop Continued
description: Continues the work of Nuit Interop (by FlashyReese) for MC 1.21.5 and 1.21.8. Automatically converts OptiFine/MCPatcher custom sky resource packs to Nuit format at runtime.
body:
# Nuit Interop Continued

This mod continues the work of [Nuit Interop](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit-interop) by FlashyReese, bringing support for Minecraft 1.21.5 and 1.21.8.

Full credit for the original implementation goes to FlashyReese.

## What it does

Automatically converts OptiFine/MCPatcher custom sky resource packs to the [Nuit](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit) skybox format at runtime, so your existing sky resource packs continue to work.

## Requirements

- [Nuit](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit) (required)

## FAQ

Nuit itself does not support OptiFine format directly — this mod bridges that gap.
